caption: The drawing features a single object, a glass or transparent container with an ornate, curved handle on the right side. The body of the container is slightly conical, wider at the base and tapering towards the top, and is adorned with floral and scroll-like embossed patterns. The top of the container is fitted with a metallic, possibly brass or bronze cap, from which two straight metallic tubes extend vertically. A small metallic whistle-like object is attached to the cap by a short chain, hanging on the left side of the container. The background is plain and beige, with no additional objects or context. The colors consist mainly of clear glass for the body, a light bluish-gray for shading, and a brownish-bronze tone for the metallic components. The artist's signature, "I Taylor Brane," is visible at the lower right below the container.
title: Lamp
